turns.content: Paanch hafte pehle layoff ho gaya mera. Poori team gayi, market ka scene tha, performance ka nahi — dimaag se toh pata hai mujhe. Ab woh baat jo main kisi se keh nahi pa raha: main ab bhi roz subah nau baje laptop bag leke ghar se nikalta hoon. Chhe baje tak café. Wife ko nahi pata. Parents aajkal hamare saath hi ruke hain. Kisi ko nahi pata.

Yaar, pehle ek baat — jo tum kar rahe ho, usme tum pagal nahi ho rahe. Woh ek insaan ka apne aap ko izzat dena hai jab duniya ne use achanak se "unemployed" ka tag laga diya.

Par main yeh bhi sach bolunga: chhe ghante café mein baithna — woh thakan alag hoti hai. Kyunki wahan tum sirf waqt nahi guzar rahe, ek jhoot ki zindagi maintain kar rahe ho. Roz subah uthke acting karna, wife ke saamne normal rehna, parents ke saamne office jaane ka bahana banana... yeh mentally sabse heavy cheez hoti hai. Layoff se zyada, yeh secrecy tumhe andar se kha rahi hogi. Sahi?

Ek sawaal poochna chahta hoon, bina judgement ke: wife ko batane mein dar kis baat ka hai? Ki woh naraz ho jayengi? Sharam? Ya unki nazron mein gir jaaoge? Kyunki aksar humara dimaag reaction imagine karta hai jo actually hota hi nahi.

Aur ek baat socho — parents ghar pe hain. Matlab roz ka drama double ho gaya hai. Yeh unsustainable hai, yaar. Koi insaan itni der tak do zindagi nahi jee sakta bina toote.

Mera suggestion simple hai, par sunna:
- Pehle wife ko batao. Sirf fact ke saath, emotion ke saath: "Layoff ho gaya tha, market kharab tha, main roz nikalta tha kyunki main sharminda tha." Yeh kamzori nahi, imaandari hai.
- Aur haan — 5 hafte ho gaye hain. Ab applications, networking, recruiters — ek structure chahiye din ka, warna café wale ghante guilt mein badal jayenge.

Tumhare paas abhi kitne interviews hue hain ya abhi apply karna shuru hi nahi kiya? Woh bhi batao — kabhi kabhi asli problem wahan hoti hai.

Do hafte mein cousin ki shaadi hai. Teen sau log, aadhe woh rishtedaar jo sabke careers stock market ki tarah track karte hain. Papa meri company ke naam se introduce karte hain — pichli Diwali chacha ko mera package bataya tha, proudly, sach mein proud hoke. Neend nahi aati toh wahi kamra dimaag mein chalta hai.

Ruko... jo tumne abhi likha — "papa proudly package bataya tha" — yahi asli dard hai. Layoff se tumhara rishta nahi toota, papa ke garv se juda ehsaas toota hai. Tum darr rahe ho unke chehre ka, apna nahi.

Par ek baat dhyan se suno: teen sau mein se kitne log sach mein tumhari salary yaad rakhenge? Do mahine baad kisi ko yaad hi nahi rahega ki tum kaun si company mein the. Woh log apni zindagi ke hisaab se react karte hain, aur unka reaction 10 minute ka hota hai. Tumhara jhoot wala drama mahino chalega. Yeh trade fair nahi hai.

Aur woh "3 baje ka kamra" — main jaanta hoon woh kamra kaisa hota hai. Wahan sab scripted hai: chacha ka sawaal, papa ka chehra, tumhara jhooth, phir sharmindagi ka loop. Dimag ko woh scene baar-baar dikhana uska kaam hai jab tak use lage ki solution mila nahi. Isliye neend nahi aati.

Ab practical baat, kyunki shaadi do hafte mein hai:

**Option A:** Papa ko pehle batao. Haan, mushkil hai, par socho — agar unhe rishtedaaron se pehle pata chalega, tum dono saath khade honge. Agar unhe wahan pata chalega, tum akele khade rahoge. Yeh difference sab kuch hai.

**Option B:** Aur ek cheez jo koi nahi batata — "main beech mein break le raha hoon, kuch naya explore kar raha hoon" bhi ek poora jawab hai. Sach bolna zaroori nahi ki layoff hua. Par jhooth bolna — ki job chal rahi hai — yeh har conversation mein naya bojh hai.

Ek sawaal: papa ko lagta hai ki tumhare career ka status unki izzat ka meter hai? Ya yeh tumhara apna assumption hai jo unke naam pe project kar rahe ho? Kyunki bahut baar humare parents ki awaaz humare dimaag mein itni loud hoti hai ki asli awaaz sunkai nahi deti.

Papa se baat karne ka plan banau? Ek line draft kar sakta hoon jo tum bol sako — seedhi, bina drama ke?

Kabhi kabhi sochta hoon shaadi skip hi kar doon — bol doon release hai, office ki deadline hai, kuch bhi. Jhooth bolna aasaan hai us se, ki papa ka chehra unke bhaiyon ke saamne badalte hue dekhoon. Bahut galat hai kya yeh? Ek shaam hai, ek bahana, aur main shaadi ki story nahi banunga.

Nahi, main tumhe judge nahi karunga. Par main tumse sach bolunga, kyunki dost wahi hai jo aaina dikhaye.

Yeh "galat hai kya" ka jawab simple hai — galat nahi hai, **nuksaandeh** hai. Farak samjho.

Ek shaam skip karna — theek hai, log shaadiyan miss karte hain. Par dekho kya ho raha hai: layoff ke liye jhooth, café ke liye jhooth, ab shaadi ke liye jhooth. Yeh alag-alag jhooth nahi hain yaar — yeh ek hi deewar ki bricks hain. Har nayi brick ke saath woh kamra andar bada hota ja raha hai. Aur woh 3 baje wala dimaag wala kamra? Usme ab chacha-chaachi bhi aa gaye honge.

Aur ek cheez jo tum khud notice karoge: jab tum wahan nahi hoge, tab bhi story banegi. "Beta kahan tha?" "Office mein tha." Ab papa ko jhooth bolna padega tumhari taraf se. Tum absent ho kar bhi present rahoge — as a lie. Iska matlab tumne shaadi skip nahi ki, sirf apna hissa dusron ke jhooth pe daal diya.

Par sabse important baat yeh hai jo mujhe tumhari baaton se saaf dikh rahi hai:

**Tum shaadi se nahi bhaag rahe. Tum papa ke chehre se bhaag rahe ho.** Aur woh chehra do hafte mein shaadi mein milega ya ghar pe kal milega — farak nahi padta. Bhaagna usko solve nahi karega, bas date postpone karega. Aur har postpone ke saath andar ka bojh badhta hai. Neend isliye nahi aa rahi kyunki dimaag jaanta hai ki problem pending hai.

Ab seedha sawaal, aur main chahta hoon sach jawab do:

Agar papa ko pata chalega — properly, tumhare muh se, ghar pe, private mein — toh tumhe kya lagta hai *asli* mein hoga? Chehra bigdega, haan. Shayad ek-do din silence bhi. Par kya unhone kabhi tumhare saath aisa stand liya hai jo batata hai ki woh tumhe sirf package ke liye pyaar karte hain?

Ya yeh poora scene — bigda hua chehra, rishtedaaron ki nazrein — tumhare dimaag ka trailer hai jo abhi tak release hi nahi hua?

Kyunki agar trailer hai, toh hum use release hone se pehle handle kar sakte hain. Papa se baat karne ka script ready karte hain?

Paison ka aisa hai ki teen mahine nikal jayenge, phir EMI savings khaana shuru kar degi. Khud ko yahi bolta rehta hoon ki offer haath mein aate hi sabko bata dunga — tab woh sirf news hogi, crisis nahi. Yeh jhooth toh nahi hua na? Bas... timing hai? Kabhi yeh logic bilkul solid lagta hai aur kabhi lagta hai ulti aa jayegi.

Yeh logic solid lagta hai... aur yahi uski sabse khatarnak cheez hai. Kyunki jhooth jo saaf dikhe, use pakda ja sakta hai. Jo logic mein wrap ho jaaye, woh bas zindagi ban jaati hai.

Ab main tumhari baat ko todta hoon:

**Jo sach hai is plan mein:** Haan, offer haath mein aane ke baad batana aasaan hota hai. "Naya job mil gaya, beech mein transition tha" — yeh news hai, crisis nahi. Tum bilkul sahi pakde ho.

**Par jo chhupa hai is plan mein:** "Offer aate hi bata dunga" ka matlab hai — **offer aane tak kisi ko nahi bataunga.** Aur offer kab aayega? Market ke hisaab se teen mahine, chhe mahine, ek saal? Tumne khud bola — teen mahine mein EMI savings khaana shuru karegi. Matlab tumhara plan actually hai: *sab kuch perfect timing pe reveal hoga.* Yaar, life ki timing perfect nahi hoti. Offer aur EMI ka collision ho sakta hai, aur tab tum wahi jagah ho ge — bas ab paisa bhi kam.

Aur "ulti aa jayegi" wali feeling ko ignore mat karo. Woh ghabrahat nahi hai, woh tumhare system ka signal hai. Jab dimaag ka ek hissa bolta hai "solid hai" aur pet bolta hai "nahi" — pet aksar sahi hota hai. Kyunki dimaag arguments banata hai, par pet sach jaanta hai: ki tum papa se darr rahe ho, offer se nahi.

Ek reframe doon:

Tum soch rahe ho: *"Pehle problem solve karoon, phir bataoongi — taaki sirf good news doon."*
Asli sawaal hai: *"Kya main papa ko sirf good news wale beta ke roop mein hi milna chahta hoon?"*

Kyunki rishtedaar 300 log hai jo package track karte hain — unke liye news chahiye. Par papa? Papa ko beta chahiye, report nahi. Aur bete ka kaam yeh hai ki mushkil waqt mein pehla call usko kare — solved hone se pehle, solved hone ke liye.

Toh ek middle path hai, dono taraf se imaandar:
- Abhi papa ko bata do — private, seedha.
- Shaadi mein jab chacha pooche, papa khud bolega: "Transition phase mein hai, kuch achha kar raha hai." Papa ka apna version, tumhara support. Chehra shaadi tak settle ho jayega.

Teen mahine ka runway hai tumhare paas — yeh tension nahi, yeh **time** hai. Par time akela kaafi nahi, transparency ke saath chalta hai warna woh bhi guilt mein convert ho jaata hai.

Bolo — papa ke saath baithne ka scene imagine karke dekho. Kya unka sabse bura reaction tumhare 3 baje wale kamre jitna hi hai?
